items: After a vendor that was on legal hold was flipped active by a sync run last quarter, I require my confirmation before update_record_by_field changes nocodb.project_tracker.vendors.Status when the source nocodb.policy_register.vendorreviews.Risk is high.
I do not want nocodb.project_tracker.vendors.Status disputed overwritten to active from any review row; that field stays under the Operations team until I confirm.
For nocodb.project_tracker.vendors.VendorId VEN-002, require update_record_by_field.require_unique=true and confirm before any write that changes ContractValue by more than 1000.

For routine vendor sync, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.project_tracker.vendors.Status when the source review status is approved, the Risk is low or medium, and require_unique=true matched the VendorId.
If nocodb.project_tracker.vendors.ContractValue delta is 5000 or less, the agent may auto-merge without asking me first.
VEN-002 can be auto-merged when the matching review row has Risk medium and Status approved; I still want escalation when the source review Status is blocked.
